klawisz.podpowiedz: Click and press a new key. Esc cancels.
klawisz.blad.ogolny: This key cannot be used: {powod}. Choose another one.
klawisz.powod.wolniej: {klawisz_wolniej} slows down the simulator and training
klawisz.powod.szybciej: {klawisz_szybciej} speeds up the simulator and training
klawisz.powod.alt_enter: Alt+Enter switches full screen in games
klawisz.powod.alt_f10: Alt+F10 saves an NVIDIA instant replay
klawisz.blad.win: Shortcuts with the Windows key cannot be used. Choose another combination.
klawisz.blad.pojedynczy: This key works only with Ctrl, Alt or Shift, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F8.
klawisz.blad.altgr: {klawisz} works as AltGr and types special characters. Choose another combination.
klawisz.blad.shift_litera: Shift with a letter types a capital letter. Add Ctrl or Alt, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+K.
klawisz.blad.te_same: Walking and running need different keys.
klawisz.blad.wlaczanie_koliduje: The control key must differ from the walking and running keys.
klawisz.blad.wlaczanie_niedozwolony: This key cannot be the control key. Choose another one.
klawisz.blad.tempo_te_same: Faster and slower need different keys.
klawisz.blad.tempo_koliduje: The faster and slower keys must differ from the control, walking and running keys.
klawisz.blad.tempo_niedozwolony: This key cannot be used to change the speed. Choose another one.
klawisz.blad.chod_z_modyfikatorem: Walking and running use single keys, without Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
klawisz.blad.nieznany: This key cannot be used. Choose another one.
